description.en: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to one designated enemy.
description.zh-CN: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

summary.en: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方单体造成少量量子属性伤害。

description.en:
There is a #2[i]% base chance to add 1 Weakness of an on-field character's Type to the target enemy. This also reduces the enemy's DMG RES to that Weakness Type by #4[i]% for #3[i] turn(s). If the enemy already has that Type Weakness, the effect of DMG RES reduction to that Weakness Type will not be triggered.
Each enemy can only have 1 Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf. When Silver Wolf implants another Weakness to the target, only the most recent implanted Weakness will be kept.
In addition, there is a #5[i]% base chance to further reduce the All-Type RES of the enemy by #6[f1]% for #7[i] turn(s).
Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to this enemy.
description.zh-CN:
有#2[i]%的基础概率为指定敌方单体目标添加1个场上我方目标持有属性的弱点，且该弱点对应属性的抗性降低#4[i]%，持续#3[i]回合。若添加的是敌方目标原有属性的弱点，则不会触发对应属性的抗性降低效果。
单个敌方目标仅能被银狼添加1个弱点，当银狼对其再次添加弱点时，仅保留最新添加的弱点。
有#5[i]%的基础概率额外使该目标的全属性抗性降低#6[f1]%，持续#7[i]回合。
对该目标造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

summary.en: There is a high chance to apply additional Weakness to one enemy and deals Quantum DMG to this enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 大概率为敌方单体添加额外的弱点，并对其造成量子属性伤害。

description.en: There's a #2[i]% base chance to decrease the target enemy's DEF by #3[f1]% for #4[i] turn(s). And at the same time, deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to the target enemy.
description.zh-CN: 有#2[i]%的基础概率使指定敌方单体防御力降低#3[f1]%，持续#4[i]回合，同时对该目标造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

summary.en: There is a high chance of lowering one enemy's DEF and deals massive Quantum DMG to this enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 大概率使敌方单体防御力降低，并对其造成大量量子属性伤害。

description.en:
Silver Wolf can create three types of Bugs: Reduce ATK by #1[f1]%, reduce DEF by #2[f1]%, and reduce SPD by #3[f1]%.
Every time Silver Wolf attacks, she has a #4[i]% base chance to implant a random Bug that lasts for #5[i] turn(s) in an enemy target.
description.zh-CN:
银狼能够制造：攻击力降低#1[f1]%、防御力降低#2[f1]%、速度降低#3[f1]%3种【缺陷】。
银狼每次施放攻击后有#4[i]%的基础概率给受到攻击的敌方目标植入1个随机【缺陷】，持续#5[i]回合。

summary.en: After this unit attacks, there is a chance of implanting the target with 1 random Bug.
summary.zh-CN: 攻击后有概率给目标植入1个随机【缺陷】。

description.en: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
description.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

summary.en: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
summary.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

description.en: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies, and ignores Weakness Types and reduces Toughness from all enemies. Enemies with their Weakness Broken in this way will trigger the Quantum Weakness Break effect.
description.zh-CN: 立即攻击敌人，进入战斗后对敌方全体造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害，并无视弱点属性削减敌方全体的韧性，击破弱点时，触发量子属性的弱点击破效果。

summary.en: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor DMG to all enemies and reduces Toughness of all enemies regardless of Weakness Types.
summary.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进战后对敌方全体造成少量伤害，并无视弱点属性削减韧性。

description.en: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to one designated enemy.
description.zh-CN: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

summary.en: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方单体造成少量量子属性伤害。

description.en:
There is a #2[i]% base chance to add 1 Weakness of an on-field ally target's Type to one designated enemy target (prioritizing the implant of a Weakness that matches the first character in the team lineup). This also reduces the enemy target's RES to that Weakness Type by #4[i]% for #3[i] turn(s). If the enemy target already has that Type of Weakness, the RES reduction effect to that Type will not be triggered.
Each enemy target can only have 1 Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf. When Silver Wolf implants another Weakness to the target, only the most recent implanted Weakness will be retained.
In addition, there is a #5[i]% base chance to further reduce the target's All-Type RES by #6[f1]% for #7[i] turn(s).
Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to this target.
description.zh-CN:
有#2[i]%的基础概率为指定敌方单体目标添加1个场上我方目标持有属性的弱点（优先添加我方编队中的第一位角色持有属性的弱点），且该弱点对应属性的抗性降低#4[i]%，持续#3[i]回合。若添加的是敌方目标原有属性的弱点，则不会触发对应属性的抗性降低效果。
单个敌方目标仅能被银狼添加1个弱点，当银狼对其再次添加弱点时，仅保留最新添加的弱点。
有#5[i]%的基础概率额外使该目标的全属性抗性降低#6[f1]%，持续#7[i]回合。
对该目标造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

summary.en: There is a high chance to apply an additional Weakness to one enemy and deals Quantum DMG to this enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 大概率为敌方单体添加额外的弱点，并对其造成量子属性伤害。

description.en: Has a #2[i]% base chance to reduce the DEF of all enemies by #3[f1]% for #4[i] turn(s). At the same time, deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies.
description.zh-CN: 有#2[i]%的基础概率使敌方全体防御力降低#3[f1]%，持续#4[i]回合，同时对敌方全体造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

summary.en: Has a high chance of reducing all enemies' DEF, and deals massive Quantum DMG to them.
summary.zh-CN: 大概率使敌方全体防御力降低，并对其造成大量量子属性伤害。

description.en:
Silver Wolf can create three types of "Bugs": Reduce ATK by #1[f1]%, reduce DEF by #2[f1]%, and reduce SPD by #3[f1]%.
After every attack launched by Silver Wolf, she has a #4[i]% base chance to implant 1 random "Bug" that lasts for #5[i] turn(s) in the attacked enemy target. 
When the enemy target gets defeated, the Weakness Silver Wolf implanted on it will be transferred to another surviving enemy on the field that hasn't been implanted with Weakness by Silver Wolf, prioritizing targets at Elite-level and above.
description.zh-CN:
银狼能够制造：攻击力降低#1[f1]%、防御力降低#2[f1]%、速度降低#3[f1]%3种【缺陷】。
银狼每次施放攻击后有#4[i]%的基础概率给受到攻击的敌方目标植入1个随机【缺陷】，持续#5[i]回合。
敌方目标被消灭时，银狼对其添加的弱点会转移给场上存活的未被银狼添加弱点的敌人，优先转移给精英级别及以上的目标。

summary.en: After an attack, there is a chance of implanting 1 random "Bug" on the target. When this enemy target gets defeated, the implanted Weakness will be transferred.
summary.zh-CN: 攻击后有概率给目标植入1个随机【缺陷】。敌方目标被消灭时，添加的弱点会转移。

description.en: After using her Ultimate to attack enemies, Silver Wolf regenerates 7 Energy for every debuff that the target enemy currently has. This effect can be triggered up to 5 time(s) in each use of her Ultimate.
description.zh-CN: 施放终结技攻击敌方目标后，目标每有1个负面效果，银狼恢复7点能量。该效果在每次终结技攻击中最多生效5次。

description.en: When an enemy enters combat, reduces their Effect RES by 20%.
description.zh-CN: 在敌方目标进入战斗时，使其效果抵抗降低20%。

description.en:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
description.zh-CN: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

description.en: After using her Ultimate to attack enemies, deals Quantum Additional DMG equal to 20% of Silver Wolf's ATK for every debuff currently on the enemy target. This effect can be triggered for a maximum of 5 time(s) during each use of her Ultimate.
description.zh-CN: 施放终结技攻击敌方目标后，目标每有1个负面效果，则额外造成等同于银狼20%攻击力的量子属性附加伤害。该效果在每次终结技攻击中最多触发5次。

description.en:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
description.zh-CN: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

description.en: For every debuff the enemy target has, the DMG dealt by Silver Wolf to it increases by 20%, up to a max increase of 100%.
description.zh-CN: 敌方目标每有1个负面效果，银狼对其造成的伤害提高20%，最多提高100%。

description.en: The duration of "Bug" is extended by #1[i] turn(s). Every time an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, Silver Wolf has a #2[i]% base chance of implanting a random "Bug" on that target.
description.zh-CN: 【缺陷】的持续时间增加#1[i]回合。每当有敌方目标的弱点被击破时，银狼有#2[i]%的基础概率对该目标植入1个随机【缺陷】。

description.en: The duration of the Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf's Skill increases by #1[i] turn(s).
description.zh-CN: 施放战技时，为敌方目标添加的弱点持续时间增加#1[i]回合。

description.en: If there are #1[i] or more debuff(s) affecting the enemy when the Skill is used, then the Skill decreases the enemy's All-Type RES by an additional #2[i]%.
description.zh-CN: 施放战技时，若敌方目标的负面效果数量大于等于#1[i]个，则战技使目标全属性抗性降低的效果额外降低#2[i]%。

description.en: The duration of "Bug" is extended by #1[i] turn(s). Every time an enemy's Weakness gets broken, Silver Wolf has a #2[i]% base chance of implanting a random "Bug" on that target.
description.zh-CN: 【缺陷】的持续时间增加#1[i]回合。每当有敌方目标的弱点被击破时，银狼有#2[i]%的基础概率对该目标植入1个随机【缺陷】。

description.en: When the battle starts, immediately regenerates #1[i] Energy. When Silver Wolf's turn starts, she regenerates #2[i] Energy.
description.zh-CN: 战斗开始时，立即恢复#1[i]点能量。银狼的回合开始时，自身恢复#2[i]点能量。

description.en: For every #1[i]% Effect Hit Rate that Silver Wolf has, additionally increases her ATK by #2[i]%, up to a max of #3[i]%.
description.zh-CN: 银狼每拥有#1[i]%效果命中，则额外提高#2[i]%攻击力，最高不超过#3[i]%。
